source: https://cursor.com/cn/home (fetched 2026-08-03; SSR HTML 837KB + 4 compiled CSS chunks; browser extension unavailable — extraction from markup/tokens plus downloaded demo wallpaper; Chinese locale of the global homepage)
assets read: marketing-static _next CSS chunks (418KB combined), /marketing-static/demos/cursor-wallpaper.png
product_context: Cursor — 'AI coding agent' (中文: 'Cursor 是您的编程智能体，助您构建雄心勃勃的软件。'); the post-2025 warm rebrand of cursor.com, fully localized zh/cn

color.palette_type: warm greige monochrome driven by ONE ink color per theme — nearly every text/border/surface tone is the fg at a color-mix(oklab) opacity step; single burnt-orange accent

light.text_ladder: text 100% / mid 50% / secondary 60% / tertiary 40% of fg

dark.note: dark theme keeps the same opacity-ladder architecture; html:has([data-origin-dark]) also flips theme

color.accent: #f54e00 burnt orange (--color-theme-accent) — the only saturated brand color; warning states borrow it
color.product_colors: ansi-green #1f8a65 / ansi-red #cf2d56 for terminal + diff UI (inserted/removed line backgrounds at 8/6% alpha)
color.agent_timeline: muted pastel coding for agent activity: thinking #dfa88f (salmon), grep #9fc9a2 (green), read #9fbbe0 (blue), edit #c0a8dd (purple)
color.insights_charts: a 10-hue chart family (orange/brown/salmon/amber/green/sky/blue/lavender/pink/red) each with secondary+tertiary dark variants — data-viz gets its own warm-tuned palette
color.contrast_strategy: soft warm ink-on-paper; hierarchy via the opacity ladder rather than distinct grays; color appears only as the orange accent, product ANSI hues, and chart/timeline palettes

typography.heading_font: CursorGothic (custom grotesque, 400/700) with cursorDisplay for display moments; EB Garamond (400–800 + italics) as --font-serif for editorial/'Insights' surfaces; Lato appears for embedded UI demos
typography.mono_font: Berkeley Mono (licensed) — terminal demos, code, agent transcripts
typography.type_scale: named type-* classes, ALL weight 400: 2xl 72px/1.1/-.03em, xl 52px/-.025em, lg 36px/-.02em, md-lg 26px/-.0125em, md 22px/-.005em, sm 14px — tracking tightens as size grows, boldness never used for headline hierarchy
typography.hero_h1: type-md-lg (26px, weight 400) with text-balance — a deliberately modest hero; the giant sizes (type-xl/2xl) are saved for the closing '立即试用 Cursor.' CTA
typography.font_style_notes: regular-weight custom grotesque everywhere + a full Garamond family for humanist/editorial contrast + Berkeley Mono for machine text — three-voice system (product / prose / terminal)

spacing.base_unit: 4px Tailwind + custom g-grid tokens (--spacing-g0.25 … g3 mapped to xs–2xl); custom breakpoint md at 660px
spacing.content_density: airy marketing sections; dense faithful product recreations inside demo frames

layout.grid_system: Next.js marketing app, max containers to 80rem; sections stacked with generous vertical rhythm
layout.homepage_structure: modest 26px h1 + download/get-started CTAs → interactive multi-surface demo (Cursor Desktop, CLI, Mission Control task queue with Chinese task cards, mobile app, browser preview of a generated 'Acme Labs' research site with EB Garamond styling) → trusted-by logos → '构建软件的全新方式。' statement → changelog + '近期亮点' highlights → giant type-xl/2xl closing CTA
layout.product_as_hero: the hero visual is a working replica of the product rendered in DOM/CSS (chrome/editor/sidebar theme tokens, phone-screen token sets, visual-feedback overlay tokens) — hundreds of bespoke CSS vars exist just to fake the app faithfully in both themes

shape.radius_scale: rounded-sm and rounded-full dominate; buttons are full pills (border-radius 3.40282e38px — max-float pill); cards 10–12px; tiny 2px radii inside product replicas
shape.border_usage: the fg-alpha border ladder (2.5→20%) does all edging; 1px borders throughout

elevation.shadow_style: soft and sparse: card shadows like 0 18px 46px at ~34% black in dark demo frames; marketing surfaces rely on the warm card-step ladder instead of shadows
elevation.depth_cues: 5-step card tonal ladder + alpha borders; glassy gradients only inside phone/demo replicas

iconography.style: geometric line icons + the angular Cursor cube logo; 110 inline SVGs on the homepage

motion.philosophy: product-demo choreography over decorative motion: keyframes are almost all for the embedded demos
motion.keyframes_observed: streaming-word-fade (LLM text streaming), shimmer / shimmer-slide, mobile-chat-enter, mobileRecordingWaveform, mobileWorking* opacity trio, mobile-interaction-glow/pulse, gallery-marquee-item-slide-up, navItemFade/SlideIn/Out, newsletter-submit-pulse, pulse-bit/emit, shake, fade-in
motion.libraries: no Three.js/GSAP detected; CSS keyframes + React

components.buttons: .btn system: primary = ink-filled pill (bg fg color, label in bg color — inverts per theme), secondary = card-03 fill + 1px soft border, ghost = transparent + 20% border, quaternary/quinary text buttons; sizes xs/sm/md-sm; weight 400 always
components.demo_frames: signature component: full theme-token recreations of Cursor Desktop (chrome/editor/product-text tokens), CLI terminal (Berkeley Mono + ansi colors), Mission Control kanban ('进行中/待审查' queues with diff stats '+135 -21'), iPhone frame (mobile-phone-* token set), visual-feedback picker overlay — the marketing site ships a working design-system replica of the product
components.agent_timeline: activity stream with per-action pastel color coding (thinking/grep/read/edit)
components.changelog_cards: dated updates + '近期亮点' highlights grid
components.wallpaper: the in-demo desktop wallpaper is an alpine-lake landscape oil painting (Bierstadt-school) — pastoral art inside the machine
components.localization: full zh-CN translation including UI demo content (任务卡片, 构建落地页) — CJK text set in the same CursorGothic/system stack

design_style.mood: warm, assured, understated, craft-heavy, quietly premium
design_style.personality: the definitive post-2025 'warm AI' rebrand: burnt orange on olive-warm greige, regular-weight custom grotesque, Garamond accents, Berkeley Mono terminals, and an oil-painting wallpaper inside the product demo — power demonstrated through a meticulous working replica rather than claimed through hype
design_style.genre: AI dev-tool marketing, painterly-warm school (the style ara.so also inhabits) — deliberately opposite the black/neon terminal aesthetic; closest structural kin to Vercel's discipline but warm-toned and serif-inflected
design_style.visual_language: one ink color per theme expanded into a full system via oklab opacity ladders; five-step warm card tonality instead of shadows; saturated color rationed to one orange accent plus product ANSI/timeline/chart hues; the product replica IS the imagery — no screenshots, no illustration
design_style.composition: understated 26px hero headline over a giant interactive product demo; statement sections in 36–52px regular weight; the only typographic shout (72px) is the final CTA; Chinese copy set with the same restraint
design_style.copy_voice: calm, ambition-flattering ('助您构建雄心勃勃的软件' — helps you build ambitious software; '构建软件的全新方式' — a new way to build software); research-lab register in the demo content ('a group of researchers, engineers, and technologists inventing at the edge of what's useful and possible')
design_style.interaction_feel: demo-driven: streaming text fades, working-state waveforms, shimmer placeholders, task cards progressing through queues — motion communicates 'the agent is working', never decoration

overview.performance_tier: lightweight-medium — all DOM/CSS; zero canvas, zero WebGL, zero videos on the homepage; 110 inline SVGs
overview.composite_notes: Extraction from SSR HTML + compiled CSS of the zh-CN homepage; interactive demo behavior (task progression, streaming) inferred from keyframe names and token sets rather than observed live. The a11y note in the DOM confirms the hero is 'an interactive demo… displayed over a subtle, solid brand background'.

product_replica_demos.details: hero is a multi-surface working replica (Desktop, CLI, Mission Control, mobile, browser preview) built from dedicated CSS token sets per surface, theme-aware light/dark, localized into Chinese

streaming_text.details: streaming-word-fade keyframe — LLM output words fade in sequentially inside demos

shimmer_placeholders.details: shimmer + shimmer-slide loading sheens on demo UI

working_indicators.details: mobileRecordingWaveform + mobileWorking horizontal/vertical/center opacity cycles + interaction glow/pulse — 'agent is busy' choreography

painting_wallpaper.details: the demo desktop's wallpaper asset is a pastel alpine-lake oil painting (Hudson River School style) — same pastoral-painting motif ara.so builds its whole identity on

glassmorphism.note: soft gradient cards inside phone demos only; no frosted blur system

text_effects.details: limited to streaming-word-fade in demos; headlines themselves static
